bullets.text: EE’s 5G+ Expansion - **EE** aims to cover 130 UK cities by 2025 with its newly branded 5G+ network.
VMO2 Launches Giga Sites - **VMO2** introduces its first Giga Site in London, enhancing 5G connectivity with advanced tech.
Nokia Acquires RIC Assets - **Nokia** enhances its 5G capabilities by absorbing **Juniper's** RIC technology for better automation.
Telecom Strategies Matter - Multifamily property owners report gaps in internet service quality and strategy execution.
AI in 3GPP Release 19 - New standards embed AI in telecoms, enhancing efficiency and performance for future networks.
Optus Network Outage - **Optus** faces backlash after another outage leaves customers unable to contact emergency services.
Samsung Partners with Vodafone - **Samsung** to supply **Vodafone** with O-RAN solutions across Europe, enhancing network flexibility.
Private 5G Meets AI - The convergence of private 5G and generative AI is set to drive Industry 4.0 innovations.
Taliban Telecoms Blackout - Afghanistan faces a severe telecom blackout imposed by the Taliban, impacting daily life.
China Tightens Telecom Regulations - **Nokia** and **Ericsson** face challenges as China restricts foreign telecom equipment usage.
